text:
We checked “The Harbour club missing 1 style” and found 3 issues in the InDesign file that are likely causing the problems in Frontify, plus 2 that may change how it looks. Here’s what to change:

Likely causing the problems

1. Font missing from the package
Frontify needs the font files to render the text, otherwise the template falls back to another font.
Where: fonts “BlairITC TT”, “BlairMdITC TT”, “Stay Dreaming” and 1 more
• Make sure the font is installed or activated on your computer.
• Package again with File > Package with "Copy Fonts" checked, and zip the whole folder, including "Document fonts".
Learn more

2. Adobe Font missing from the package
Frontify only uses fonts included in the package; it can’t load Adobe Fonts from your Adobe account.
Where: the font “Montserrat (OTF)”
• Package again with File > Package and "Copy Fonts" checked, and check that the font’s files are in "Document fonts".
• If InDesign won’t copy the Adobe Font, use a licensed desktop copy of the font (or another font) instead.
Learn more

3. Text frame has no paragraph style
Frontify uses paragraph styles to format text and decide what can be edited.
Where: the text frame “Extra information if needed” (page 2)
• Select the frame and apply a paragraph style in Window > Styles > Paragraph Styles (any style except [Basic Paragraph] or [No Paragraph Style]).
Learn more

May change how it looks

4. Hyphenation is on
Browsers hyphenate differently from InDesign, so lines may break in different places.
Where: paragraph styles “kop goud”, “Arrangement”, “prijs” and 4 more, used on pages 1–2
• In the paragraph style, go to Hyphenation and uncheck Hyphenate.
Learn more

5. Paragraph Composer used
The Adobe Paragraph Composer breaks lines differently from browsers, so text may reflow in Frontify.
Where: paragraph styles “kop wit”, “kop goud”, “intro Harbour Club” and 7 more, used on pages 1–2
• In the paragraph style, go to Justification and set Composer to Adobe Single-line Composer.
Learn more

Once that’s done, package the document again with File > Package, zip the package folder and upload it to Frontify.
